name: OrbiSearch Public API
description:
Email verification API for developers and agents. [Get your API key →](https://orbisearch.com/dashboard/api-keys)

**Rate limiting:** requests are limited per API key (20 requests per second by default). Every response includes `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers describing the current per-key window so clients can self-throttle; `429` responses also include a `Retry-After` header with the suggested backoff in seconds.
